newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise sharply, other areas sluggish.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise sharply, other areas sluggish.

text.p: ARA fuel oil bunkers rose sharply on Wednesday, spurring reasonable trade, while other areas were sluggish both in terms of price movements and business, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst rose from $111 fob to $115 in the morning and $116/$117 delivered in the afternoon. Dealers said there were a large number of small enquiries from shipowners eager to cover and fearful of further rises. Total demand amounted to over 10,000 tonnes, dealers said.
Hamburg prices were steady and trading was dormant except for a few small enquiries.
Mediterranean prices were also stable. Spanish ports received a few enquiries, but most other areas were quiet.
Dealers in many other ports said initial enquiries did not result in trades.
Fujairah bunkers were flat, taking their lead from Singapore levels.
Durban was still experiencing shortages for fuel oil bunkers which was not expected to be resolved until October.
